rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACared
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, before 1976).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) in 1978 as 'American Pride'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. None to mild fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered, spiral centers bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright, well-branched. Large, leathery foliage. 5 to 7 leaflets.

Height: up to 4' (up to 120cm). Width: up to 3' (up to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
